_comment: Dimwit capability registry (task 9). Each entry = a named DESIGN/DEVELOP/EXECUTE/TEST verb mapped to an existing function via module:function. verify_all() asserts every target resolves (task 16). Add rows as more tools are wrapped; this is the single dispatch surface the director, brain-agent loop, and MCP server share.
